out_of_engine_mechanics.name: CurJackpotStoreWin progressive (test-interface-zeroed)
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' is present on every ST1/ST31 round but =0 on 100% of the in-sample records (40000 + 942). FLEET-WIDE test-interface behavior (user-confirmed 2026-06-12 during M275 gate 8, recorded once per machine): it IS a real progressive jackpot store, but the CURRENT testspin interface forces its accumulation efficiency to 0 (so the sample correctly shows 0). Parse as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST1/ST31 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the interface is optimized to populate it, the existing parser picks it up unchanged. The data RTP is the BASE RTP (excludes the progressive); the progressive ADDS on top once the interface enables it.
